{{Top|leg}}
A '''xenozoologist''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who specialized in [[xenozoology]], the study of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] wildlife. [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] xenozoologists were unable to classify all the dangerous animals in the forests of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] in the five centuries after its settlement. They also mistakenly believed that the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] native species [[Menahuun]] had been completely wiped out.
